reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: (MIA) patients reaches or approaches 100%, while the prognosis for IAC is relatively poorer [6]. According to the clas-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: sification criteria of IASLC/ATS/ERS from 2011, atypical adenomatous hyperplasia (AAH), distinct from AIS, MIA, and

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: IAC, corresponds to squamous dysplasia and typically measures less than 5 mm [7]. Some studies suggest that the

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: treatment time window for lung cancer includes the AIS and MIA stages in pathology [8]. Surgical intervention is not

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: recommended for AAH. Therefore, this study excluded nodules with pathological results indicating AAH.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: Sublobar resection is suitable for AIS/MIA patients [9], whereas the surgical approach for IAC patients is more

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: complicated, possibly related to factors like nodule size [10, 11]. This requires surgeons to select appropriate surgical

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: methods based on potential pulmonary nodule pathology. Studies have confirmed that preparing rapid intraopera-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: tive frozen sections and deciding whether to expand the surgical plan based on intraoperative pathology results can

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: effectively guide surgical procedures and have been widely adopted [12, 13]. FS can effectively identify early lesions

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: [14], opting for a more conservative surgical approach to protect the patient's healthy lung tissue [15]. According to

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: the JCOG series studies results, nodules with a diameter greater than 3 cm should undergo pulmonary lobectomy.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: In comparison nodules with a diameter of 3 cm or less should have their surgical approaches determined with CTR

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: [16]. The choice of surgical approach for such nodules can be challenging, and the accuracy of FS is particularly

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: crucial in these cases.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: However, FS has some errors due to the histological heterogeneity of lung adenocarcinoma, errors in sampling and

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: interpretation, and suboptimal sample quality, among others. Due to variations in the expertise level among patholo-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: gists in different medical institutions, the accuracy of FS varies significantly [14, 17-19]. Much research currently predicts

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: nodule infiltration levels through CT imaging characteristics, revealing that predicting IAC patients using CT features

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: like the nodule diameter, CTR, or radiomics has a high accuracy rate [20, 21]. This research aims to study the CT imaging

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: characteristics of FS upgrade patients, identify lung nodule patients prone to FS upgrades.

exact_original_source_line: 2 Methods

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: This research project was approved by the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University. Individual patient

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: informed consent was waived due to the anonymous data management and the retrospective nature of this study.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 2.1 Patients

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: This research involves a retrospective analysis. The study retrospectively analyzed patients who underwent lung surgery

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: at the First Affiliated Hospital of Nanjing Medical University from January to December 2019. Inclusion and exclusion

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: criteria were set as follows:

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: Inclusion Criteria:

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 1. Postoperative pathology suggested adenocarcinoma;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 2. No neoadjuvant treatment before surgery;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 3. Only a single lung nodule was operated on, or for multiple nodules, only the one with the highest degree of infiltra-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: tion was studied.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: Exclusion Criteria:

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 1. Incomplete medical records or imaging data.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 2. Patients with other lung diseases affecting the measurement accuracy such as pneumonia, interstitial lung disease,

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: tuberculosis, etc.;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 3. Previous lung surgery on the same side;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 4. Metastatic tumors from other organs in the lung;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 5. Pathology results as AAH;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 6. Purely solid nodules;

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: 7. Nodule diameter > 3 cm;

exact_original_source_line: 2.2.1 Evaluation of radiologic findings

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: The imaging software was set to a lung window width of 1,600 Hu and window level of -600 Hu. Two radiologists spe-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: cializing in thoracic imaging and one thoracic surgeon jointly reviewed the images. Before reviewing, the data was

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: anonymized; the three doctors were unaware of the patient's basic information, surgical plan, and pathological results.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: The diameter of the nodule and the solid component were measured in the cross-sectional view, and the average was

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: taken from the measurements made by the three doctors. The CTR was calculated as the diameter of the solid compo-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: nent divided by the diameter of the nodule, following the measurement standards recommended by the Fleischner

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: Society [22].

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]

exact_original_source_line: 2.3 Statistical analysis

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: All statistical analyses and prediction model were completed using the R language. Firstly, univariate analysis was con-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: ducted on the patients' clinical baseline characteristics. When there was significant difference, a 1:2 propensity score

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: matching was used to balance the baseline characteristics. Univariate analysis was used to filter radiological features

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: with group differences. Quantitative data were tested using t-tests, while quantitative data were subjected to a χ 2 test.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: Features with a P value less than 0.05 were included in the multivariate analysis to identify independent risk factors affect-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: ing outcomes. Specifically, when comparing Group 1 with Group 2 in order to build a prediction model, LASSO regression

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: was employed to select independent risk factors and to simplify the model. Logistic regression was then used to build

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: the prediction model, and ROC curves and nomograms were plotted. When comparing Group 2 with Group 3, to retain

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: all potential independent risk factors, logistic regression was applied to select independent risk factors and calculated

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: the AUC and cut-off values for continuous variables. A P value less than 0.05 was considered statistically significant.

exact_original_source_line: 3.1 Consistency between FS and FP

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: The study included a total of 860 patients. Among these, 614 patients had consistent pathology results between FS

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: and FP, yielding an overall accuracy rate of 71.40%. When we grouped AAH, AIS, and MIA as the non-IAC category,

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: the overall FS accuracy rate reached 84.19%. For IAC patients, the accuracy rate was 74.40%. For those diagnosed as

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: non-IAC, the FS upgrade rate was 26.67%. (Table 1).

exact_original_source_line: We focused our study on nodules posing diagnostic and surgical challenges. Therefore, we excluded a consider-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: able number of nodules with a diameter > 3 cm or pure solid nodules during subject selection. Due to their higher

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: malignancy, these nodules are more likely to be diagnosed as IAC during FS, thus enhancing the overall accuracy.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: This perspective is supported by a study focusing on FS for AIS/MIA, where the concordance rate between FS and FP

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: was only 63.24% [18],seemingly confirming our viewpoint. About 26.67% of patients diagnosed with AAH/AIS/MIA

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: by FS are upgraded to IAC upon FP diagnosis. Among IAC patients, approximately 25.6% are underestimated during

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: FS diagnosis. This group might have been chosen for sub-lobar resection based on intraoperative FS, resulting in

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: inadequate surgical margins. The necessity for a second surgery remains controversial [23, 24]. In the study by Zhang

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: et al. [23], patients who were upgraded from AAH/AIS/MIA to IAC had 5-year survival and relapse-free rates of 100%,

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: regardless of whether they underwent a second surgery. In the study by Su et al. [25] two patients who underwent

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: sub-lobar resection and were upgraded post-operatively experienced local recurrence. They believed that a second

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: surgery was necessary for patients with FS upgrade.

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: The optimal solution to this problem is to improve the accuracy of FS. Some studies indicate that sampling errors dur-

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: ing slide preparation are the main factor affecting FS accuracy [26]. However, meticulously studying each pathological

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
exact_original_source_line: specimen would consume a lot of pathologist's time and energy and would not meet clinical needs. Hence, it's vital to

reasons: ["Unfiltered emitted source block."]
